data.name: Kennedy Space Center Adventure and CHAT with an Astronaut
data.headline: All ages • Approx. 10.5 Hours
data.description:
#Kennedy Space Center Chat with an Astronaut

##Duration

Approx. 10.5 Hours

## About This Tour

When you want to take your space exploration a step further, what better way to enjoy the KSC than with one of the people who actually makes it all happen – one of NASA’s very own astronauts.

Not only will you be whisked to the Visitor Complex with all the convenience and efficiency of Real Florida Adventures transport, you will also be first in line for one of THE great personalized experiences the Space Center has to offer.

Set in a purpose-designed intimate venue at the Visitors Complex you will be introduced to some common astronaut traditions before engaging in a question and answer with one of NASA’s amazing Astronauts. During this 45 minute to an hour session, you’ll be able to ask those well thought out questions to see what it’s really like to work for NASA and be one of the few to travel into orbit.

During the Chat enjoy a sampling of food and beverage while having your group conversation. Each guest will receive a commemorative gift and a lithograph (signed portrait) of the astronaut.

Of course, you will still have plenty of time to explore the rest of the Space Center and soak up the amazing, dynamic vibe of the modern KSC, which has been dramatically revamped in recent years to really immerse visitors in both the history and the future of space exploration.

There is a LOT to discover, but don’t miss the awe-inspiring Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit, complete with the Shuttle Launch Experience, the Heroes & Legends center, incorporating the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame, the majestic Rocket Garden, and the fabulous IMAX Theater, with its larger-than-life movie features.



**Included**
• Admission into Kennedy Space Center Visitors complex
• A continental breakfast in the morning, or chef’s choice of culinary samplings in the afternoon
• 1 alcoholic drink per adult ticket (more available for purchase)
• A commemorative gift and lithograph (signed portrait) of the astronaut
• Roundtrip Transportation from International Drive, Disney and Kissimmee areas
• Professional, Certified and Licensed Tour Guide

**Not included**
•	Meals and Drinks not mentioned
•	Gratuities
